reading_source: All 138 sample sentences manually reviewed against the annotated reference-card text and conjugation context. 来 readings checked per form: き/こ/く; lexical 刃 は retained while topic は → わ, object を → お. Lexical は in はやく/はんぶん/はなした preserved. Long vowels, doubled consonants and katakana readings checked. Speech-only commas follow complete clauses/phrases, never immediately before particles. Exact display sentences and lookup keys unchanged.
notes: Sample sentences only; headings, forms, formation notes, common-word lists and connection-guide fragments remain silent. Marin generation speed 1.0. Provisional natural Tokyo intonation authorized by persistent AGENTS.md. Format and input checks are not listening verification.
